question: Who among the following is the author of 'Vishesh: Code To Win'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirupama Yadav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled “Vishesh: Code To Win” is authored by Nirupama Yadav, the sportswoman-turned-author. 
 
• The book was released on the occasion of National Sports Day on August 29.
 
• The book is based on the life of **Vishesh Bhriguvanshi**, India’s youngest basketball team captain.
 
• The objective of the book is to inspire youth to choose sports that can lead them to get success in their career.
 
• The book has also explained the mindset of a basketball player in the age of a cricket-dominated era and how it is difficult to maintain the tempo when the whole nation is driving towards one sport only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ashis Ray:**

 
 
• He is the author of Cricket World Cup: The Indian Challenge is the most comprehensive offering on the subject and is eminently readable as an essential reference.
 
• It covers all 10 previous World Cups in detail from an Indian perspective, highlighting the 1983 and 2011 competitions, which India won.
 
• Ashis Ray's One-Day Cricket: The Indian Challenge, published in 2007, became a bestseller in India.​
